Just came back from a trip to chiang rai and noticed this restaurant hasn’t been mentioned by anyone on here. I randomly found Baan Plai Na Restaurant in Wiang Kalong Town and it was honestly the absolute best meal we had in chiang mai/chiang rai. We went to several Michelin rated restaurants and this was better than all of them. It’s farm to table and everything was super fresh. Would highly recommend stopping by here on your way to chiang rai.
